name: Compressed air
body:
Source People of the Stars pg. 19
Price 50 gp; Weight 10 lbs.
Category Tools
Description
Longer lasting than an air bladder (Ultimate Equipment 58), a jar of compressed air comes with a breathing apparatus that can be strapped over the mouth with a leather cord and provides enough air for a Medium character to breathe normally for 10 minutes (20 minutes for a Small character).
